name: Niina Saki
source:
A first year in university, children nursing course. 
Saki is Aimi and Yumeno's cousin and is currently attending university far away from the village. From the sisters' perspective she is like a big sister to them, and when they were in the village they very often played together.

At first glance she gives off a cool impression, but that's because her expression doesn't show her feelings much and she herself is quite bothered by it. Saki isn't too good at talking with men and ends up acting very stiff, which ends up adding even more cool impression to her.

She has a caring side to her and can't leave a troubled person without help.

Saki loves children and wants to become a kindergarten teacher, but secretly, she is afraid that she would scare the children...
